A round sticky note that rides on whatever window you are using.

**WormholeNotes-Setup.exe** installs to Program Files with an optional Start
Menu shortcut, and starts WormholeNotes at sign-in unless told not to. Silent
install: `/S`. Options off: `/O:start_menu=off`, `/O:desktop=off`,
`/O:sign_in=off`.

**The portable zip** runs from wherever you unzip it. Nothing to install.

**The Firefox .xpi**, when attached, is the browser extension signed by
Mozilla. Open it in Firefox to install it.

The installer and WormholeNotes.exe are signed by Specter Point Intelligence,
LLC.

Windows 10 1809 or later, x64.
